fields.name: Password reset
fields.summary: Help a user regain access without exposing whether an account exists.
fields.expected_outcome: A legitimate user can reset a password safely, while tokens expire and old sessions are handled correctly.

fields.title: Request reset for a known account
steps: Open the test email and follow the link.
fields.expected: The form gives a neutral confirmation, the link works once, and the new password signs the user in or returns them to sign-in.

fields.title: Expired or reused reset link
steps: Use an expired link or submit the same link twice.
fields.expected: The old link is rejected with a clear recovery path. No token or account detail is exposed.

fields.name: Checkout
fields.summary: Let a customer complete an order with clear states and safe payment boundaries.
fields.expected_outcome: The order state stays accurate through validation, processing, success, decline, timeout, and retry.

fields.title: Payment provider timeout
steps: Add an item and start checkout.
fields.expected: The user sees a recoverable state, the order is not duplicated, and sensitive payment values are not stored in logs.

fields.name: Search
fields.summary: Help users find relevant items quickly across empty, partial, and failed states.
fields.expected_outcome: Users can search by keyboard, understand result states, and recover from no results or service errors.

fields.title: No results and recovery
steps: Search for a term with no matches.
Change the query and submit again.
fields.expected: The empty state explains what happened and gives the user a clear next action without losing the search context.
